privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Reyeltor-uz helps people find and list property in Tashkent. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.collectIntro: When you use the app, we may collect and store:
privacy.collectPhone: Phone number — to create your account and let buyers reach you
privacy.collectEmail: Email address (optional) — for sign-in and password recovery
privacy.collectListings: Listing details — property information you choose to publish (price, location, description, and similar fields)
privacy.collectPhotos: Photos — images you upload for your listings
privacy.noSellTitle: We do not sell your data
privacy.noSellBody: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their marketing. We use your data only to operate Reyeltor-uz — for example, to show listings, manage your account, and improve the service.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this policy or your data, email us at:
privacy.collectTelegram: Telegram details — when you register, our bot @Reyeltor_uz_bot receives the phone number and name you share, plus your Telegram ID and username, to confirm your number and recover your password
privacy.collectAlerts: Your last map search and the price of listings you save — to alert you about new matching listings and price drops of 3% or more (you can switch these off)

affordability.description: How much property can you afford?
affordability.monthlyLivingExpensesNote: Rent, food, utilities, transport, and other regular costs
affordability.monthlyDebtPaymentsNote: Other loans and credit payments (not the new mortgage)
affordability.targetPriceNote: Apartment or commercial unit you plan to buy
affordability.cashOnlyAfford: Cash purchase only (no additional mortgage capacity)
affordability.incomeLimitedNote: Existing debt payments already exceed 35% of income. Banks are unlikely to approve a new loan.
affordability.livingLimitedNote: Living expenses and debt payments use all or more of your income. No room left for a mortgage payment.
affordability.livingCappedNote: Your living expenses limit how much you can pay monthly — result uses the lower of bank rules and money left after bills.
affordability.disclaimer: Based on 35% debt-to-income ratio. Uzbek banks typically require 20–30% down payment.
